messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — compliance flagged a permission-change row in the quarterly audit export with actor=null. KMS request id present though.
Luca Rossi: Do we have the event id or any correlating KMS logs? Group sync / terraform could be suspects.
Maya Chen: Event: permission.change @ 2024-11-28T18:06:50Z. target=user:svc-data-migrator, change=add role:infra-admin, actor=null, kms_req=kr-7b2a. KMS audit shows a DECRYPT/Sign with request kr-7b2a.
Anika Patel: Can you paste the exact audit line?
Maya Chen: ```
2024-11-28T18:06:50Z permission.change {"event_id":"evt-9c3","target":"user:svc-data-migrator","change":"add role:infra-admin","actor":null,"auth_method":"kms-encrypted-signature","kms_req":"kr-7b2a"}
```
Luca Rossi: Huh — auth_method implies a signed operation but actor stripped. Maybe the ingestion pipeline drops actor when proto payload > threshold? @audit-bot, any matches for kr-7b2a?
audit-bot: audit-bot: Matched kr-7b2a -> principal=svc-orchestrator@redwood.internal in KMS logs. Ingestion trace shows a proto->json conversion path that omitted optional actor field for large payloads. Creating ticket.
Maya Chen: :eyes: That would explain the null. Compliance already flagged the export row as missing "who". We need to fix provenance before the compliance deadline.
Samir Kapoor: I can take the ingestion proto->json bug. Sounds like a codec edge-case introduced in v2.3.2.
Anika Patel: Short-term mitigation: exporter can backfill actor from kms_req when actor==null. We should surface provenance (inferred_from_kms) for auditability. Who can own a quick patch?
Luca Rossi: I’ll own the exporter patch and produce a supplemental CSV mapping event_id -> inferred_actor + reason. ETA EOD today if no surprises.
Compliance_Michelle: Please do NOT modify original audit rows. We require an unaltered audit trail. Supplemental mapping with signed attestations is acceptable.
Maya Chen: Good catch. Action items: 1) Luca: exporter supplemental CSV + PR (owner Luca). 2) Samir/Anika: triage and fix proto->json conversion bug (owner eng-security). 3) Compliance (Michelle): verify supplemental mapping and confirm whether re-export is allowed. 4) Create a short postmortem if the missing actor changes any compliance decisions.
Luca Rossi: I'll add a column inferred_actor and provenance_notes in the CSV, sign with the compliance key, and attach to ticket #4622.
audit-bot: audit-bot: Created tickets #4621 (ingestion proto->json loss) and #4622 (export supplemental mapping).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Planning a canary deploy for the exporter change at 23:00 UTC. Will monitor errors and pause on failures.
Anika Patel: For the long-term fix: add unit tests for optional actor in proto schema and add an integration test that replays KMS-signed events.
Maya Chen: Compliance asked for a one-line rationale to include with the mapping file. Luca can you draft?
Luca Rossi: Drafted. Will ping when PR is ready.
Compliance_Michelle: Received. Please ensure mapping includes event_id, inferred_actor, inference_method, confidence (high/medium/low), and signer.
Samir Kapoor: Noted. Will prioritize the proto fix tomorrow morning and link to #4621.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. Keeping this thread as the coordination channel. :thumbsup:
Luca Rossi: thanks :thumbsup:
Anika Patel: tacking onto follow-up: check other exporters (s3 vs bigquery) for same conversion code path. Might be broader.
Maya Chen: Added to action items.
